def layout():
    L = {}
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] > 20: continue
        bs = n['boundary']
        rr = (min(q[0] for q in bs)+max(q[0] for q in bs))//2
        cc = (min(q[1] for q in bs)+max(q[1] for q in bs))//2

        if n['color'] not in 'OprbNYMR': continue
        key = ('r' if rr < 30 else 'g') + str(1 if cc<26 else 2 if cc<33 else 3 if cc<39 else 4)
        L[key] = n['color']
    return L
L = layout()
print('layout:', L)
